column1: # Custom 8MB partition table (ESP32-S3 DevKit-1 N8R8): OTA-capable layout
# (nvs + otadata + ota_0 + ota_1 + coredump + spiffs). With 8MB of flash the
# two app slots grow to 3.375MB each — plenty for the NHL data-layer rewrite
# (v1.3 filled 93.7% of the old 1.5MB slots) — plus a roomy LittleFS for
# config/assets and a coredump slot so crash dumps survive reboots.
